title.zh: 将北达沃省第一区的San Mariano市镇更名为Maragusan市镇的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Municipality of San Mariano in the First District of the Province of Davao Del Norte to Municipality of Maragusan
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Municipality of San Mariano in the First District of the Province of Davao Del Norte to Municipality of Maragusan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1988/ra_6678_1988.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Municipality of San Mariano in the first district of Davao del Norte shall hereafter be known as the Municipality of Maragusan.
All laws or decrees inconsistent with any provision of this Act are hereby deemed amended accordingly.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
